packages.title: FolderPlex
packages.shortDescription: Fast, lightweight Plex client for LG TVs with remote-friendly navigation: browse libraries by Plex metadata or real server folders, shuffle any folder or show, auto-play next with a countdown.
packages.description: FolderPlex is a fast, lightweight Plex client built for LG webOS 4+ TVs. Instant navigation: cached libraries open immediately, posters are resized by the server, and remote control movement is tuned for older TV hardware. Improved remote navigation: a clearly highlighted focus, long-press OK (or the blue button) for quick actions, and focus that returns to where you left off. English and Russian interface. Browse your libraries with Plex metadata (including your manual match fixes) or switch to the real folder structure from the server. Sort by title, date added, release date or recently watched, remembered per library. Play in order or shuffle any folder, library or TV show across all seasons, with auto-play of the next video and an adjustable countdown. Direct play with hardware decoding (MKV, MP4, HEVC, AC3), automatic fallback to server transcoding, resume and watch-state sync with Plex. Unofficial app, not affiliated with Plex Inc.

packages.title: Архив Вещания
packages.shortDescription: Смотрит на телевизоре мультфильмы, фильмы, сказки и радиоспектакли, уже скачанные на домашний сервер с Android-устройств. С сайтом архива не соединяется.
packages.description: Только просмотр с домашнего сервера: «Скачанное» и «История». На сервер скачивают Android-устройства (приложение «Архив Вещания»), телевизор лишь показывает. Общие места остановки со всеми устройствами, «Что дальше?» среди скачанного. Никаких соединений с сайтом архива. Нужен домашний помощник на Linux-сервере (одна команда): https://i1yanov.github.io/fp/av/
